article.title: 따라서
article.part: Discurso académico y conversación — 학술 담화와 회화
article.chapter: Conectores académicos y organización del discurso — 학술 연결 표현과 담화 구성

claims.summary: NIKL defines 따라서 as a connective adverb indicating that the previously mentioned event is the cause, reason or basis for what follows.
NIKL distinguishes 따라서, 그래서, 그러므로 and 그리하여 by definition and says naturalness depends on full context.

locator.description: NIKL 온라인가나다, heading and answer, lines 162–170 and 191–196.
locator.detail: Lines 167–170 define 그래서/따라서/그러므로/그리하여; lines 195–196 say that without full context it is difficult to judge which connective is more natural.
